subject: Add tag for dual-channel logs (#999)
reason: The change only adds a '<Dual Channel> ' prefix to dual-channel replication log messages via a new dualChannelServerLog macro (compile-time string concatenation of the format literal) and rewords one log line, updating the matching Tcl test. No command reply, replication protocol byte, state transition, or data path changes — only server-log text at unchanged log levels. The fuzzer's oracles (replies, ledger, deployment state, liveness) cannot observe log wording, so no scenario can exercise or detect this change; any macro misuse would be a compile error already caught by the build.
